title: Add request-level Prometheus/OTel metrics and KV-cache latency histograms for inference
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Current Prometheus/OTel pipeline lacks request-level labels and fine-grained KV-cache latency measurements. We see gaps in tail-latency attribution (P95/P99) and inability to correlate slow tokens to traces. This makes debugging regressions and quantifying the cost/latency tradeoffs of caching/quantization difficult.

Goal: Instrument the inference runtime to emit request-scoped metrics (histograms/counters) with controlled label cardinality and exemplar linkage to traces. Add a KV-cache latency histogram and a cache_hit label to generation latency metrics. Ensure metrics are exported via our OTel collector and scraped into Prometheus with exemplar support. Update dashboards and alerts to use the new metrics.

Scope: Runtime metrics SDK changes, tracer->metrics exemplar wiring, otel-collector pipeline config, Prometheus scrape/remote-write rules, Grafana dashboards and alerts, e2e and perf tests. Keep rollout toggle to disable high-cardinality labels if needed.
acceptance_criteria: New metrics documented and visible in test Prometheus: inference_request_duration_seconds histogram with labels {model,route,instance_type,cache_hit}
Exemplars present on histogram buckets linking to trace IDs for high-latency samples
KV-cache latency metric exposed: inference_kv_cache_latency_seconds histogram with buckets tuned for micro-to-millisecond latencies
Dashboards updated (latency by model/route, cache_hit breakdown, error rate by error_type) and added P95/P99 panels
Alert rules created: increased P99 latency or cache_miss spike triggers paging and creates a runbook link
Cardinality controls in place: tenant_id hashed/aggregated and label whitelist implemented
Load test shows <2% additional p95 CPU overhead at 1000 qps for metrics path in our staging cluster
tasks: Design metrics schema and bucket boundaries (telemetry + product review)
Add OTel Metrics instrumentation to runtime: emit histograms and counters with controlled labels
Wire exemplar ids from tracer (trace_id) into metric exemplars for slow buckets
Add KV-cache instrumentation: measure lookup latency, hit/miss, and population time
Update otel-collector config to include metrics exporters and exemplar forwarding
Update Prometheus scrape/remote-write config and retention for new metrics
Create Grafana dashboard panels and new alerting rules (ops + SRE review)
Run e2e integration tests, perf benchmark, and smoke tests in staging
Canary rollout on Dedicated pool and monitor for cardinality/ingestion cost
